class.name: CSGHeightMapLayer
class.description: Overrides the vertical thickness and slope of one quantized height-map layer. Its position in [member CSGHeightMap3D.layer_settings] is the layer ID.

members.member: Relative thickness of the interval ending at this layer. Weights are normalized so the highest layer still reaches the top of [member CSGHeightMap3D.size]. Index 0 uses [member CSGHeightMap3D.base_thickness].
Slope width for this layer. A negative value inherits [member CSGHeightMap3D.slope_width]. This setting only affects contour-layer generation.
